intent.caption: Brand mark wall — A 3x2 wall of monochrome brand-mark tiles rendered premium on machined tiles — no icon-pack styling.

visualSpec.effects: Six machined tiles 1.0w x 0.62h scene units in a 3x2 grid, gap 0.25 (1x base unit), grid total 3.5w x 1.49h centered at origin with the kicker 0.3 units above; each tile brushed-metal PBR, anisotropy strength 0.6 aligned to x, roughness 0.55, metalness 0.5, clearcoat 0.2, albedo vertical ramp #1a1a22 (at 0.0) -> #121218 (at 1.0), chamfered edges 0.02 units; brand wordmarks rendered flat monochrome #e8ecf2 at 78 percent opacity, no drop shadows, no strokes, no icon-pack styling; hover per tile wordmark opacity 0.78 -> 1.0 and tile translateZ 0 -> 0.05 over 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); mount stagger-cards with each tile fade-up opacity 0 -> 1 and y +0.2 -> 0 over 500ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94) at 80ms stagger, top row left-to-right first; key light rakes at 35deg elevation so the brushed anisotropic highlight sweeps across each tile as it settles, giving the wall visible material motion without color noise.

sceneSpec.motionNote: Tiles fade-up in an 80ms left-to-right stagger while the brushed specular band sweeps each tile; hover lifts a tile 0.05 units.
sceneSpec.contrastMinimum: 4.5:1 wordmarks at rest opacity on tile albedo; kicker on background exceeds 15:1
